description: Get the full details of one public job posting from its URL on Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io or job-boards.greenhouse.io), Lever (jobs.lever.co) or Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com): title, employer, location, department, employment type, workplace, posted date, pay where the posting shows it, the description as plain text (at most 8000 characters) and the apply link, read from each vendor's public job-board API. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

url.description: The posting's address, such as https://jobs.lever.co/<company>/<id> or https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/<company>/jobs/<id>.

name: data_job_details
title: Get one job posting's details
